evidence: The complete body zeroes a 64-byte output record, fills its first two 32-bit values from helpers, then writes many one-byte results from accepted attribute-context status predicates and status lookups into the record (decompiled/main/main_0006.c:35575-35828). Its indexed caller invokes it while processing a context/player-state record (decompiled/main/main_0030.c:10542; caller behavior includes process_context_and_player_state).

The body reads fields from the attribute record, uses the accepted sum_attribute_context_modifier_values and average_attribute_context_modifier_value helpers among its calculation path, and writes derived 16-bit values back into the record (decompiled/main/main_0082.c:22484-23247; writes at 22693 and 22733, repeated at 22992 and 23034). The indexed caller is in the recompute_attribute_record_metrics path and calls this routine on the record (decompiled/main/main_0082.c:18812; caller evidence row at decompiled/function_behavior.tsv:36003).

The body queries multiple attribute-context status selectors including 1 and 0x13, branches across status-dependent paths, and invokes the accepted check_diamond_dynasty_context_status helper as part of the evaluation (decompiled/main/main_0086.c:35275-35868; helper call at 35457, status queries at 35290-35316). The indexed caller invokes it only after preparing context inputs and passes through two output/context arguments (decompiled/main/main_0088.c:42452).

The body obtains context attribute values, converts them to float, applies linear_remap_clamped and map_integer_to_float_curve helpers, and also incorporates aggregate_related_attribute_values in its floating-point calculation path (decompiled/main/main_0027.c:2769-3112; helper sequence visible at 2788 onward and vector calculation through 3106). Its indexed caller uses the result while evaluating a context-dependent attribute branch (decompiled/main/main_0025.c:20279-20285).

The routine checks existing state flags, attribute-context status selectors, player/nested attribute values and state-entry conditions; on allowed paths it dispatches a state callback, updates byte flags on the input record, and writes the resulting state value (decompiled/main/main_0120.c:18510-18702; writes at 18521, 18583, 18613, 18619, 18631, 18688). Its indexed caller is a broader validate_attribute_edit_state routine (decompiled/main/main_0120.c:16564; behavior row decompiled/function_behavior.tsv:50987).
